test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Cardamom hills are located in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The famous Cardamom hill is located in the Western Ghats.

 
 
• Cardamom Hills is in southeastern Kerala.
 
• The Cardamom Hills region is famous for the production of tea, coffee, teak, and bamboo as well as cardamom.
 
• The name cardamom hills come from the cardamom spice grown in much of the hills.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Western Ghats

 
• They are also known as Sahyadri in Maharashtra, Nilgiri hills in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, Anaimalai hills (Highest Peak-2695 m), and Cardamom hills in Kerala.
 
• They are an elevated and continuous range of mountains.
 
• The average elevation is about 1500 m.
